parts.title: Hypergendered Logic
parts.explanation: Opening scope/front matter. It identifies HGL as an invented formal treatment of recursively structured fictional femaleness/maleness across logical, causal, phenotypic, metaexpressive, modal, hypercategorical, inheritance, dimensional, flaw/unflaw and transcardinal-quality layers. It is source-identity metadata rather than a standalone operator axiom.
do_not_confuse_with: A claim about real human biology.

parts.title: Preface: what this document is
parts.explanation: The interpretation contract for HGL. It requires readers to track negation scope, distinguish ordinary classical transformations from HGL-specific operations, and separate strict deduction, broader HGL inference, causal deduction and causal inference. It also explicitly confines the framework to fictional formal biology rather than real-world medical theory.
reader_prerequisites: Distinguish formal syntax from biological interpretation.
do_not_confuse_with: A guarantee that every illustrative morphology is logically forced.

parts.title: Executive orientation
parts.explanation: Systemmap for current HGL. PA tracks irreducible developmental-causal mode, IH tracks inheritance/source provenance, PH tracks irreducible possession of a source considered as a whole phenotype-profile, and Γ is the global Archstage meta-phenotype governing phenotype expression. Higher categories are not a percentage-over-100 reading. Archstage progression and ordinary woman/man maturation are separate axes, so fixed stage does not imply biological stasis.
reader_prerequisites: Archstage and ordinary development are separate axes.

parts.title: Part I — The formal vocabulary
source_subheads: Primitive PA modes and category typing
parts.explanation: Grammar-and-type foundation. x=XX and y=XY are inner condition atoms. PA maps inner conditions to irreducible developmental modes; IH preserves inherited logical/state properties plus exact source provenance; PH gives irreducible possession of the complete phenotype-profile of a source as a whole; Γ governs stage-level phenotype-expression rules. The central anti-collapse laws are: PA(A∧B) does not decompose into PA(A)∧PA(B); IH(Z) implies Z but not conversely; IH(¬Z) is not ¬IH(Z); PH(¬Z) is not ¬PH(Z); PH is neither PA nor IH; and Boolean equivalence inside an operator does not license operator distribution.
reader_prerequisites: Separate substitution of equivalent inner formulas from distribution.
do_not_confuse_with: A fixed Γ with biological stasis.

parts.title: Part II — The deontic epiphany and scope of negation
source_subheads: No nested PA, no self-referential same-stage PH
Why deontic logic was the crucial analogy
parts.explanation: The deontic analogy isolates HGL’s key scope law: negating an operator-applied state is not the same as applying the operator to negated content. ¬PA(φ) says the PA-state due to φ does not obtain; PA(¬φ) is a positively specified developmental mode caused by the negated condition. Hence Unfemale PA(¬x) is not mere non-Female ¬PA(x), and Unmale PA(¬y) is not mere non-Male ¬PA(y). Higher antithetical productivity is likewise not magic negation: the positive step comes when IH inherits a structured whole-state non-state, IH(¬S).
do_not_confuse_with: IH(¬S) with negation itself generating phenotype.

parts.title: Part III — De Morgan’s laws, carefully and at multiple levels
parts.explanation: Classical De Morgan equivalence remains valid at the Boolean depth where NOT actually scopes. It may normalize a Boolean condition inside PA and may rewrite an outer conjunction/disjunction of already-formed HGL atoms. It does not move NOT through PA, IH or PH. Thus PA(¬(¬x∧y)) may normalize internally to PA(x∨¬y), while ¬PA(¬x∧y) may not be converted to PA(x∨¬y) by De Morgan alone. The discipline rule is scope-first simplification.

parts.title: Part IV — First-order Suprafemale and Supramale
parts.explanation: Corrected Stage-1 base case: SF1=PA(x AND NOT y) and its exact mirror SM1=PA(NOT x AND y). Each is one irreducibly joint PA source. No IH, PH, UD or FD term is constitutive of Stage 1. PA irreducibility blocks deriving separate PA(x) and PA(¬y) routes from SF1, or separate PA(¬x) and PA(y) routes from SM1. FemaleType(SF1)/MaleType(SM1) are separate category axioms rather than PA-distribution rules.
reader_prerequisites: Category typing is distinct from causal route possession.
do_not_confuse_with: SF1 as two independent PA modes.
Earlier editions with constitutive Stage-1 IH/PH.

parts.title: Part V — Second-order Hypergendered states: inherited states plus whole-state phenotypes
source_subheads: Stage-2 phenotype antithesis versus ordinary non-possession
parts.explanation: Stage 2 is the first multi-axis enriched state. SF2/SM2 each contain eight conjuncts: inherited same-side predecessor, inherited opposite-side non-state, positive PH of the same-side predecessor, explicit NOT-PH exclusion of the opposite predecessor profile, UD of the same-side predecessor, two standalone PA routes newly explicit at Stage 2, and NOT-FD of the same-side predecessor. This simultaneously records causal-mode enrichment, inheritance provenance, whole-profile status and UD/FD structure. Negating the whole conjunction uses outer De Morgan only; NOT does not migrate through IH, PH, PA, UD or FD.
do_not_confuse_with: Stage-2 standalone PA routes with decomposition of Stage 1.
source_cautions: The preserved Component-4 prose locally contains wording that treats NOT PH(SM1) as if it were positive possession of a non-SM1 profile, while the same part’s explicit Stage-2 antithesis section, formulas and De Morgan expansion distinguish NOT PH(SM1) from PH(NOT SM1). This explanation preserves that internal conflict as a caution rather than silently collapsing the constructions.

parts.title: Part VI — Third-order Suprafemale and Supramale under IH + PH
source_subheads: The five-way distinction for any source S
parts.explanation: Stage 3 makes source-depth explicit. HGL distinguishes S, ¬S, IH(S), IH(¬S), PH(S), PH(¬S), plus outer ¬IH(S) and ¬PH(S). SF3 inherits SF2, inherits the structured non-state of SM2, positively possesses PH(SF2), explicitly satisfies NOT PH(SM2), carries UD(SF2) and NOT FD(SF2); SM3 mirrors it. The whole Stage-2 state therefore becomes a new inheritance source and same-side phenotype-profile source. The gain is recursive provenance depth, not merely repetition of projected truth values.
do_not_confuse_with: Direct provenance relations with their transitive logical consequences.

parts.title: Part VII — General higher-order architecture
source_subheads: Why Stage 3 is genuinely richer than Stage 2
PH laws for the higher ladder
Why higher order is not phenotype-count arithmetic
parts.explanation: The finite local SF/SM successor sector is generalized. Each successor inherits the same-side predecessor and the structured non-state of the corresponding opposite predecessor, positively possesses the same-side predecessor’s whole phenotype-profile, explicitly excludes the opposite predecessor’s whole profile with NOT PH, carries UD of its predecessor and NOT FD of that predecessor. The part codifies PH laws, retains nonflattening IH laws, defines stage-source inheritance depth and a separate phenotype-source order. These recursive measures grow without implying a linear visible-trait count: provenance and whole-profile source order can deepen even where Boolean projections overlap.
do_not_confuse_with: Truth-functional novelty with full HGL-state novelty.
Positive PH(same-side predecessor) with NOT PH(opposite predecessor).
